'''Minazar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and member of the [[Scions of Zakuul]]. He was part of the Scions' contingent in the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|assault]] on [[Kira Carsen's ship]] around [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> and was killed along with his comrades by the [[Servant]]s.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />
